newsitem.title: ITALY: Price set at 99.95 at 3-yr Italy Btp bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Price set at 99.95 at 3-yr Italy Btp bond auction.

text.p: Auction results for a first tranche of 5.5 trillion lire worth of three-year Italian Treasury fixed rate bonds (Btp) with a 6.00 pct coupon, and a first tranche of 5.0 trillion lire of five-year Btps carrying a 6.25 pct coupon.
Note - Comparisons with a previous auction on December 18 are not valid as that was of an 11th tranche of three and five-year Btps with coupons of 7.50 percent and 7.75 percent respectively.

At the previous auction of October 1, 1999 Btps the net yield was 5.32 percent and gross yield 6.26 percent. For the September 15, 2001 paper, the net yield was 5.74 percent and gross yield 6.71 percent.
